descriptions.en: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
descriptions.zh: 不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。

descriptions.en: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
descriptions.zh: 财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。

descriptions.en: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
descriptions.zh: 嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。

descriptions.en: Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
descriptions.zh: 欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。

descriptions.en: Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
descriptions.zh: 当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。

descriptions.en: Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
descriptions.zh: 知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。

descriptions.en: Money begets money.
descriptions.zh: 钱生钱。

descriptions.en: Charity is power. More charity is more power.
descriptions.zh: 给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。

descriptions.en: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
descriptions.zh: 避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。

descriptions.en: Fulfill desire and others will. Follow.
descriptions.zh: 当你能满足欲望，他人会，蜂拥追随。

descriptions.en: We are Desire. Ours is the grasping golden hand. We. Are. Corpus.
descriptions.zh: 我们是欲望的化身。我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们，是， Corpus。

descriptions.en: This insectoid plant’s hardy disposition makes it a great, low-maintenance addition to any space.
descriptions.zh: 这种类昆虫植物的顽强性格，使其对任意空间来说都是一种绝佳的易养护的装饰品。

descriptions.en: The functional elegance of Orokin design makes this a versatile piece for storage or display.

descriptions.en: With its antiqued metal and delicate gold accents, this Orokin floor piece adds grace and style to any room.
descriptions.zh: 通过使用古式金属和精致的金色装饰，这件奥罗金地面装饰可以为任意房间增添典雅和格调。

descriptions.zh: 散发着金色阳光气息的红葡萄酒。Ash 在莱弗博物馆的历史不由让人质疑鲜血是否比红酒更加浓郁。

descriptions.zh: 一个王座，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中对王宫的描述。

descriptions.en: An ingenious device for arithmetic. Used to keep track of a shopkeeper’s sales, a kingdom’s wealth, or the seemingly endless spiral of time.
descriptions.zh: 一个精巧的算术装置。用来记录店主的销售、王境的财富，或者看似无穷无尽的时间螺旋。

descriptions.en: Duviri citizens are expected to keep clean at all times, in case Thrax’s gaze should fall upon them.
descriptions.zh: 双衍王境的公民必须时刻保持干净，以防士魂大帝的目光落在他们身上。

descriptions.en: A replica of the cryptic monument that overshadows the many graves of Duviri.
descriptions.zh: 掩盖双衍王境众多坟墓的神秘墓碑复制品。

descriptions.en: Ideal for appreciating Bombastine’s performances. Cushioned to avoid uncomfortable posterior numbness.
descriptions.zh: 非常适合欣赏蓬蓬士君的表演。有缓冲，以避免久坐的麻木不适。

descriptions.en: The style of chair that would be occupied by Duviri’s elected government, if it had one.
descriptions.zh: 如果双衍王境的民选政府真实存在，那么一定用的是这种风格的座椅。

descriptions.en: Standard fodder for the Kaithes of Duviri, doubling as a humble bed for the weary laborer.
descriptions.zh: 双衍王境里绝灵骥的标准饲料，同时也是疲惫工人的简陋床铺。

descriptions.en: Even the lowest Duviri citizen may need to reach a high spot from time to time.
descriptions.zh: 即使是最底层的双衍王境公民，时不时也需要到达一些高度。

descriptions.en: A sturdy table on which to enjoy the nutritious dole of simple grains which Thrax’s generosity has blessed you with.
descriptions.zh: 一张坚固的桌子，在上面你可以享受由士魂大帝慷慨赐予的营养丰富的简单谷物。

descriptions.en: Ideal for lecturing, preaching, or reading magnificent poetic compositions to a crowd who does not understand or appreciate them.
descriptions.zh: 是向不理解或不懂得欣赏的凡夫俗子们演讲、布教或诵读宏伟的诗歌作品的理想选择。

descriptions.en: Used to weigh out meager, everyday goods by meager, everyday merchants.
descriptions.zh: 用来给普通商人称量微不足道的日常物品。

descriptions.en: For those times when turning into an Orowyrm is not an option.
descriptions.zh: 适用于无法变成奥金魇龙的时候。

descriptions.en: Thrax has, grudgingly, allowed his citizens the use of these screens for the preservation of personal modesty. There are some places where even his exalted eyes have no business peering.
descriptions.zh: 士魂大帝勉强允许他的公民使用这些屏风来维护个人的隐私。有些地方即使是他那双尊贵的眼睛也无权窥视。

descriptions.en: Draft and redraft endless bureaucratic scrolls with this fine Duviri desk.
descriptions.zh: 用这张精美的双衍王境书桌，反复起草没完没了的官僚文书。

descriptions.en: An elegant depiction of the fabled Orowyrm.
descriptions.zh: 优雅地描绘了传说中的奥金魇龙。

names.zh: 奥金魇龙的圣所展示图

names.zh: 鲁莎卡少校的帽子纪念品

names.zh: 鲁莎卡少校的勋章纪念品

names.zh: 双衍王境的英雄展示图

descriptions.en: The Watchful Paragrimm chooses to watch over those with keen minds.
descriptions.zh: 警惕的幽幽鹰选择守望那些思维敏锐的人。

descriptions.en: An instructive storybook by Euleria Entrati.
descriptions.zh: 由欧拉瑞娅·英择谛写的一本具有教育意义的故事书。

descriptions.en: An ornate display, created by Sillfix.
descriptions.zh: 一张华丽的展示图，由 Sillfix 创作。

descriptions.zh: 在仲裁之中，死亡阴影隐现之处，生命之火燃得最旺。这座光的雕塑致敬了那种求生的精神。

descriptions.zh: 一把镀金的椅子，上面铺着上好的丝绸。这是坐下来沉思宇宙和外宇宙的绝佳位置。

descriptions.en: An unorthodox chair of Albrecht Entrati’s own design.
descriptions.zh: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛自己设计的一把另类椅子。

descriptions.en: Curl up on the same chaise lounge that Albrecht Entrati’s favorite pet, Kalymos, once did.
descriptions.zh: 蜷缩在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛最喜欢的宠物卡利莫斯曾经呆过的躺椅上。

descriptions.en: Cast an aura of sophistication with this Entrati Chandelier.
descriptions.zh: 用这款英择谛吊灯营造出精致的氛围。

descriptions.en: An elegant Candelabra that once adorned the secret laboratories of Albrecht Entrati.
descriptions.zh: 曾经装饰过阿尔布雷希特·英择谛秘密实验室的优雅烛台。

descriptions.en: A grand, gilded Candelabra originally found in the depths of Albrecht Entrati’s labs.
descriptions.zh: 最初在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛实验室深处发现的宏伟镀金烛台。

descriptions.en: Create a timeless look with this wall sconce, plucked from the depths of Albrecht Entrati’s Deimos laboratory.

descriptions.zh: 使用这款英择谛沙发椅放松并思考未知。
